pullRequest.title: fix: fence stale Claude suggestions and uncertain Codex samples
pullRequest.body: ## Problem Two opt-in prompt-suggestion paths can lose the identity or cancellation ownership of their original native work. Claude can restore A's suggestion slot after B was already accepted, and its wire event cannot identify a late A frame after B completes. Codex drops the sent sample's cancellation handle when its local RPC timeout expires, allowing later auxiliary work while the original sample remains unknown. ## Scope and current stage This isolated repair branch preserves all 43 commits and both Thinking changes through `9423f600dfb04d04448326dbced89919924b0b5f`. It does not move PR #8's shared head. The published R1 is §14 of `docs/plans/2026-11-14-native-next-prompt-suggestions.md`, commit `3ac086d1c157645faa358f0578f8dc764c950d66`. The current stage contains documentation only. Two additive finite-fixture test files come next. Both actual semantic REDs and independent source review are required before the bounded Claude Session and Codex app-server producer changes. The intended behavior is auxiliary-only lifetime quarantine for ambiguous Claude attribution and an unknown-sample latch plus at-most-once cancellation of Codex's original sent request. Ordinary inputs, readiness, queueing, deadlines, interactions and physical cleanup remain under their existing contracts. Suggestions remain default-off. ## Validation and boundaries Use the unchanged original `pnpm check` CI on Node 24.21.0 and 26.11.1 with pnpm 11.18.0, including both packed consumers. Earlier 9423 results—540 controlled passes and its checked archive pair—remain historical evidence and do not qualify the repair. Retain exact-head RED/GREEN logs and the newly checked archive pair before any separate atomic consumer adoption. Keep this PR Draft. The four original workflows were reviewed: safe CI is reachable; the Codex native job is Draft-skipped; Claude native and native OpenCode V2 paths do not match this bounded repair. No real Claude/Codex executable, SDK process, model request or version command; no manual dispatch, rerun, cancellation, native qualification or deadline extension. Product composer work and application archive/SPI adoption are outside this PR. --- ## Summary by cubic Fences stale Claude suggestions and uncertain Codex samples in the optional prompt-suggestion paths before any producer change. - Appends a documentation-only R1 to `docs/plans/2026-11-14-native-next-prompt-suggestions.md` that pins the exact source preimages, the four-path edit boundary, and the required finite RED tests. - Adds fixtured RED cases to `claude-sdk.test.ts` and `codex-subprocess.test.ts` exposing the accepted-queue overtaking and local timeout cancellation-loss defects. These tests are expected to fail against the unchanged producers. - Keeps all 43 commits of provider PR #8 intact without moving its shared head. Suggestions remain default-off; no real Claude/Codex process is invoked. Written for commit 8a2c75bdbfafdbfd0e3014f3a62b261357c9b6c5. Summary will update on new commits.
